title: Blue Notebook Review!
description:
Blue Notebook Review: Latest Update from SMPD

This week’s Blue Notebook highlights the work happening across Santa Monica—focused on safety, accountability, and community engagement.

HLP Team:
Officers responded to 194 calls for service and conducted 156 proactive contacts, addressing 11 encampments, making 21 arrests, and issuing 35 citations. In one case, officers used a mobile fingerprint reader to identify a subject hiding under a tree—confirmed as a registered sex offender wanted out of Arizona and taken into custody on an extradition warrant.

Patrol: 
Teams handled 2,489 calls for service and made 98 arrests. Incidents included a domestic violence arrest involving a barricaded suspect. 

Traffic Safety:
Officers conducted 455 traffic stops and issued 337 citations. Targeted enforcement operations led to 65 stops and 61 citations, with a noted scooter collision on Oceanfront Walk.

Community Engagement:
Our CET continues meeting with neighborhood and business groups to share updates and prevention strategies.

Join us at upcoming events:
• Burgers with the Police – April 30 at Pier Burger
• Cookies with the Cops – May 4 at Junior Cookies (Main Street)
